summary: Dany Lavoie visual style for BIONIC zones verified. All 8 features tested and passing. Circles display thick borders (4-6px), semi-transparent fill (20-35%), vivid saturated colors, concentric circles in high probability zones, no shadow/glow effects, and thick dashed corridor lines. Style remains consistent across zoom levels.

issues: Code comment says '50-70%' fill opacity but actual implementation is 20-35% - comment should be updated for clarity

critical_code_review_comments: getStrokeWeight() correctly returns 4-6px based on percentage (4, 4.5, 5, 6 for hover)
getFillOpacity() returns 0.20-0.40 for semi-transparency - terrain visible through circles
Concentric circles use fill=false with solid lines (no dashArray) as per Dany Lavoie style
CorridorLine uses dashArray='15, 10' for thick visible dashes with width=5
CSS has no box-shadow or filter effects on .bionic-zone-circle elements
